description.value: Orion Chinese Restaurant has been a community fixture in Dawson Creek for over 30 years, serving authentic Chinese cuisine including signature dishes like crispy ginger beef and hot and sour soup. Family-owned and operated, it offers both dine-in and takeout and sits in the heart of Dawson Creek, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through Northern BC.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at orionrestaurant.ca positively identifies this as 'Orion Chinese Restaurant' at 910 102 Ave, Dawson Creek BC, with phone (250) 782-9732, confirming the OSM URL. Takeout is confirmed by multiple website passages ('grabbing takeout for a night in,' 'picking up takeout'). No evidence appears on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null; the OSM cuisine tags (steak_house;seafood) are contradicted by the website, which describes an exclusively Chinese menu.
concerns: OSM name 'Orion' differs from the business's own branding 'Orion Chinese Restaurant' on the website.
OSM cuisine tag includes 'steak_house;seafood' but the website describes an exclusively Chinese menu; OSM tags appear inaccurate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, long-established restaurant in Dawson Creek with an active website and confirmed takeout service; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Northern BC.
